comparison.objective: Shuck an oyster while preserving the cup and hand clearance, not configure machinery.
comparison.physical_skill: Hinge-gap knife insertion, twisting, muscle cutting, and shell handling.
comparison.success_condition: Hinge and muscle are freed in order, cup stays level, hand stays 3 cm from the tip, and shell is discarded.
comparison.reason: It tests staged cutting-tool manipulation on a deformable object.
